description: This file contains a series of unit tests for the navigation utilities in the openclaw project, specifically testing functions related to navigation tab icons, titles, subtitles, path normalization, tab extraction from paths, and groupings of tabs.

methods.name: iconForTab
methods.description: Returns the icon name associated with a given tab identifier.

methods.name: titleForTab
methods.description: Provides the display title for a given tab identifier.

methods.name: subtitleForTab
methods.description: Provides a descriptive subtitle for a specific tab.

methods.name: normalizeBasePath
methods.description: Normalizes a base path string by ensuring it starts with a slash and has no trailing slash.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a URL path by ensuring it starts with a slash and removes trailing slash except for root.

methods.name: pathForTab
methods.description: Constructs the URL path for a given tab, optionally prepended with a base path.

methods.name: tabFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the tab identifier from a URL path, considering optional base paths.

methods.name: inferBasePathFromPathname
methods.description: Infers the base path from a URL pathname to handle nesting.

ctags.name: ALL_TABS
ctags.pattern: /^const ALL_TABS: Tab[] = TAB_GROUPS.flatMap((group) => group.tabs) as Tab[];$/
